applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies - Auditor’s Report) Directions, 2026

answer.action: Auditors of NBFCs must submit additional reports to the board of directors and exception reports to the RBI regarding regulatory compliance.
answer.action_quote: the auditor shall also make a separate report to the Board of Directors of the Company on the matters specified in the sections below.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into effect immediately upon issuance.

answer.amends: Non-Banking Financial Companies Auditor’s Report (Reserve Bank) Directions, 2016
